description: Air Corridors Emulation, published by John Kesler through the AERPAW dataset directory, implements a multi-UAV movement model using Docker and ArduPilot software-in-the-loop. The model represents a three-dimensional grid with 26 adjacent moves and a minimum separation of two units. A coordinator opens and closes corridors, permits one UAV in a narrow corridor, and manages routing. Each UAV and the coordinator run in separate containers. The provider describes turbulence and asynchronous take-off settings. The model supports agent-based simulation of aerial traffic coordination and route optimisation. Coverage is an emulated experiment, with no operational airport or airspace deployment established. Access is through a linked IEEE DataPort landing; licence, cost and account requirements are not established in the reviewed metadata. Caveats include unverified package availability and the absence of executed validation here. Related AERPAW wireless measurement records describe communications experiments separately.
